31: // Spans transforms a slice of OpenTelemetry spans into a slice of OTLP
32: // ResourceSpans.
33: func Spans(sdl []tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan) []*tracepb.ResourceSpans {
34: 	if len(sdl) == 0 {
35: 		return nil
36: 	}
37: 
38: 	rsm := make(map[attribute.Distinct]*tracepb.ResourceSpans)
39: 
40: 	type ilsKey struct {
41: 		r  attribute.Distinct
42: 		il instrumentation.Library
43: 	}
44: 	ilsm := make(map[ilsKey]*tracepb.InstrumentationLibrarySpans)
45: 
46: 	var resources int
47: 	for _, sd := range sdl {
48: 		if sd == nil {
49: 			continue
50: 		}
51: 
52: 		rKey := sd.Resource().Equivalent()
53: 		iKey := ilsKey{
54: 			r:  rKey,
55: 			il: sd.InstrumentationLibrary(),
56: 		}
57: 		ils, iOk := ilsm[iKey]
58: 		if !iOk {
59: 			// Either the resource or instrumentation library were unknown.
60: 			ils = &tracepb.InstrumentationLibrarySpans{
61: 				InstrumentationLibrary: instrumentationLibrary(sd.InstrumentationLibrary()),
62: 				Spans:                  []*tracepb.Span{},
63: 			}
64: 		}
65: 		ils.Spans = append(ils.Spans, span(sd))
66: 		ilsm[iKey] = ils
67: 
68: 		rs, rOk := rsm[rKey]
69: 		if !rOk {
70: 			resources++
71: 			// The resource was unknown.
72: 			rs = &tracepb.ResourceSpans{
73: 				Resource:                    Resource(sd.Resource()),
74: 				InstrumentationLibrarySpans: []*tracepb.InstrumentationLibrarySpans{ils},
75: 			}
76: 			rsm[rKey] = rs
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 
80: 		// The resource has been seen before. Check if the instrumentation
81: 		// library lookup was unknown because if so we need to add it to the
82: 		// ResourceSpans. Otherwise, the instrumentation library has already
83: 		// been seen and the append we did above will be included it in the
84: 		// InstrumentationLibrarySpans reference.
85: 		if !iOk {
86: 			rs.InstrumentationLibrarySpans = append(rs.InstrumentationLibrarySpans, ils)
87: 		}
88: 	}
89: 
90: 	// Transform the categorized map into a slice
91: 	rss := make([]*tracepb.ResourceSpans, 0, resources)
92: 	for _, rs := range rsm {
93: 		rss = append(rss, rs)
94: 	}
95: 	return rss
96: }

98: // span transforms a Span into an OTLP span.
99: func span(sd tracesdk.ReadOnlySpan) *tracepb.Span {
100: 	if sd == nil {
101: 		return nil
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	tid := sd.SpanContext().TraceID()
105: 	sid := sd.SpanContext().SpanID()
106: 
107: 	s := &tracepb.Span{
108: 		TraceId:                tid[:],
109: 		SpanId:                 sid[:],
110: 		TraceState:             sd.SpanContext().TraceState().String(),
111: 		Status:                 status(sd.Status().Code, sd.Status().Description),
112: 		StartTimeUnixNano:      uint64(sd.StartTime().UnixNano()),
113: 		EndTimeUnixNano:        uint64(sd.EndTime().UnixNano()),
114: 		Links:                  links(sd.Links()),
115: 		Kind:                   spanKind(sd.SpanKind()),
116: 		Name:                   sd.Name(),
117: 		Attributes:             Attributes(sd.Attributes()),
118: 		Events:                 spanEvents(sd.Events()),
119: 		DroppedAttributesCount: uint32(sd.DroppedAttributes()),
120: 		DroppedEventsCount:     uint32(sd.DroppedEvents()),
121: 		DroppedLinksCount:      uint32(sd.DroppedLinks()),
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	if psid := sd.Parent().SpanID(); psid.IsValid() {
125: 		s.ParentSpanId = psid[:]
126: 	}
127: 
128: 	return s
129: }
130: 
131: // status transform a span code and message into an OTLP span status.
132: func status(status codes.Code, message string) *tracepb.Status {
133: 	var c tracepb.Status_StatusCode
134: 	switch status {
135: 	case codes.Error:
136: 		c = tracepb.Status_STATUS_CODE_ERROR
137: 	default:
138: 		c = tracepb.Status_STATUS_CODE_OK
139: 	}
140: 	return &tracepb.Status{
141: 		Code:    c,
142: 		Message: message,
143: 	}
144: }
145: 
146: // links transforms span Links to OTLP span links.
147: func links(links []trace.Link) []*tracepb.Span_Link {
148: 	if len(links) == 0 {
149: 		return nil
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	sl := make([]*tracepb.Span_Link, 0, len(links))
153: 	for _, otLink := range links {
154: 		// This redefinition is necessary to prevent otLink.*ID[:] copies
155: 		// being reused -- in short we need a new otLink per iteration.
156: 		otLink := otLink
157: 
158: 		tid := otLink.SpanContext.TraceID()
159: 		sid := otLink.SpanContext.SpanID()
160: 
161: 		sl = append(sl, &tracepb.Span_Link{
162: 			TraceId:    tid[:],
163: 			SpanId:     sid[:],
164: 			Attributes: Attributes(otLink.Attributes),
165: 		})
166: 	}
167: 	return sl
168: }
169: 
170: // spanEvents transforms span Events to an OTLP span events.
171: func spanEvents(es []tracesdk.Event) []*tracepb.Span_Event {
172: 	if len(es) == 0 {
173: 		return nil
174: 	}
175: 
176: 	evCount := len(es)
177: 	if evCount > maxEventsPerSpan {
178: 		evCount = maxEventsPerSpan
179: 	}
180: 	events := make([]*tracepb.Span_Event, 0, evCount)
181: 	nEvents := 0
182: 
183: 	// Transform message events
184: 	for _, e := range es {
185: 		if nEvents >= maxEventsPerSpan {
186: 			break
187: 		}
188: 		nEvents++
189: 		events = append(events,
190: 			&tracepb.Span_Event{
191: 				Name:         e.Name,
192: 				TimeUnixNano: uint64(e.Time.UnixNano()),
193: 				Attributes:   Attributes(e.Attributes),
194: 				// TODO (rghetia) : Add Drop Counts when supported.
195: 			},
196: 		)
197: 	}
198: 
199: 	return events
200: }
201: 
202: // spanKind transforms a SpanKind to an OTLP span kind.
203: func spanKind(kind trace.SpanKind) tracepb.Span_SpanKind {
204: 	switch kind {
205: 	case trace.SpanKindInternal:
206: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL
207: 	case trace.SpanKindClient:
208: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_CLIENT
209: 	case trace.SpanKindServer:
210: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_SERVER
211: 	case trace.SpanKindProducer:
212: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER
213: 	case trace.SpanKindConsumer:
214: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER
215: 	default:
216: 		return tracepb.Span_SPAN_KIND_UNSPECIFIED
217: 	}
218: }

61: // result is the product of transforming Records into OTLP Metrics.
62: type result struct {
63: 	Resource               *resource.Resource
64: 	InstrumentationLibrary instrumentation.Library
65: 	Metric                 *metricpb.Metric
66: 	Err                    error
67: }
68: 
69: // toNanos returns the number of nanoseconds since the UNIX epoch.
70: func toNanos(t time.Time) uint64 {
71: 	if t.IsZero() {
72: 		return 0
73: 	}
74: 	return uint64(t.UnixNano())
75: }
76: 
77: // CheckpointSet transforms all records contained in a checkpoint into
78: // batched OTLP ResourceMetrics.
79: func CheckpointSet(ctx context.Context, exportSelector export.ExportKindSelector, cps export.CheckpointSet, numWorkers uint) ([]*metricpb.ResourceMetrics, error) {
80: 	records, errc := source(ctx, exportSelector, cps)
81: 
82: 	// Start a fixed number of goroutines to transform records.
83: 	transformed := make(chan result)
84: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
85: 	wg.Add(int(numWorkers))
86: 	for i := uint(0); i < numWorkers; i++ {
87: 		go func() {
88: 			defer wg.Done()
89: 			transformer(ctx, exportSelector, records, transformed)
90: 		}()
91: 	}
92: 	go func() {
93: 		wg.Wait()
94: 		close(transformed)
95: 	}()
96: 
97: 	// Synchronously collect the transformed records and transmit.
98: 	rms, err := sink(ctx, transformed)
99: 	if err != nil {
100: 		return nil, err
101: 	}
102: 
103: 	// source is complete, check for any errors.
104: 	if err := <-errc; err != nil {
105: 		return nil, err
106: 	}
107: 	return rms, nil
108: }
109: 
110: // source starts a goroutine that sends each one of the Records yielded by
111: // the CheckpointSet on the returned chan. Any error encoutered will be sent
112: // on the returned error chan after seeding is complete.
113: func source(ctx context.Context, exportSelector export.ExportKindSelector, cps export.CheckpointSet) (<-chan export.Record, <-chan error) {
114: 	errc := make(chan error, 1)
115: 	out := make(chan export.Record)
116: 	// Seed records into process.
117: 	go func() {
118: 		defer close(out)
119: 		// No select is needed since errc is buffered.
120: 		errc <- cps.ForEach(exportSelector, func(r export.Record) error {
121: 			select {
122: 			case <-ctx.Done():
123: 				return ErrContextCanceled
124: 			case out <- r:
125: 			}
126: 			return nil
127: 		})
128: 	}()
129: 	return out, errc
130: }
131: 
132: // transformer transforms records read from the passed in chan into
133: // OTLP Metrics which are sent on the out chan.
134: func transformer(ctx context.Context, exportSelector export.ExportKindSelector, in <-chan export.Record, out chan<- result) {
135: 	for r := range in {
136: 		m, err := Record(exportSelector, r)
137: 		// Propagate errors, but do not send empty results.
138: 		if err == nil && m == nil {
139: 			continue
140: 		}
141: 		res := result{
142: 			Resource: r.Resource(),
143: 			InstrumentationLibrary: instrumentation.Library{
144: 				Name:    r.Descriptor().InstrumentationName(),
145: 				Version: r.Descriptor().InstrumentationVersion(),
146: 			},
147: 			Metric: m,
148: 			Err:    err,
149: 		}
150: 		select {
151: 		case <-ctx.Done():
152: 			return
153: 		case out <- res:
154: 		}
155: 	}
156: }
157: 
158: // sink collects transformed Records and batches them.
159: //
160: // Any errors encoutered transforming input will be reported with an
161: // ErrTransforming as well as the completed ResourceMetrics. It is up to the
162: // caller to handle any incorrect data in these ResourceMetrics.
163: func sink(ctx context.Context, in <-chan result) ([]*metricpb.ResourceMetrics, error) {
164: 	var errStrings []string
165: 
166: 	type resourceBatch struct {
167: 		Resource *resourcepb.Resource
168: 		// Group by instrumentation library name and then the MetricDescriptor.
169: 		InstrumentationLibraryBatches map[instrumentation.Library]map[string]*metricpb.Metric
170: 	}
171: 
172: 	// group by unique Resource string.
173: 	grouped := make(map[attribute.Distinct]resourceBatch)
174: 	for res := range in {
175: 		if res.Err != nil {
176: 			errStrings = append(errStrings, res.Err.Error())
177: 			continue
178: 		}
179: 
180: 		rID := res.Resource.Equivalent()
181: 		rb, ok := grouped[rID]
182: 		if !ok {
183: 			rb = resourceBatch{
184: 				Resource:                      Resource(res.Resource),
185: 				InstrumentationLibraryBatches: make(map[instrumentation.Library]map[string]*metricpb.Metric),
186: 			}
187: 			grouped[rID] = rb
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		mb, ok := rb.InstrumentationLibraryBatches[res.InstrumentationLibrary]
191: 		if !ok {
192: 			mb = make(map[string]*metricpb.Metric)
193: 			rb.InstrumentationLibraryBatches[res.InstrumentationLibrary] = mb
194: 		}
195: 
196: 		mID := res.Metric.GetName()
197: 		m, ok := mb[mID]
198: 		if !ok {
199: 			mb[mID] = res.Metric

201: 		}

205: 		case *metricpb.Metric_IntHistogram:
206: 			m.GetIntHistogram().DataPoints = append(m.GetIntHistogram().DataPoints, res.Metric.GetIntHistogram().DataPoints...)
207: 		case *metricpb.Metric_IntSum:
208: 			m.GetIntSum().DataPoints = append(m.GetIntSum().DataPoints, res.Metric.GetIntSum().DataPoints...)
209: 		case *metricpb.Metric_DoubleGauge:
210: 			m.GetDoubleGauge().DataPoints = append(m.GetDoubleGauge().DataPoints, res.Metric.GetDoubleGauge().DataPoints...)
211: 		case *metricpb.Metric_DoubleHistogram:
